```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/nm.R")

# The section leads say how far back the trend charts go ("since 2020").
# Use the latest first year among the neighborhoods that have a data panel,
# so the sentence is true for every neighborhood a reader can select.
nbhd_files <- c("nbhd-demographics", "nbhd-economic", "nbhd-housing",
                "nbhd-education", "nbhd-transportation", "nbhd-childcare")
data_nbhds <- c("Pottstown", "West Davidson", "Smithville", "Huntington Green")
first_years <- unlist(lapply(nbhd_files, function(f) {
  d <- nm_data(f)
  sapply(data_nbhds, function(n) {
    y <- d$year[d$neighborhood_name == n]
    if (!length(y)) stop(f, " has no rows for ", n, call. = FALSE)
    min(y)
  })
}))
since_year <- max(first_years)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {Plot, stdPlot, responsive, loadData} from "/js/nm-charts.js"

// Page-local metadata: header text for each neighborhood and the name used
// in the nbhd-*.json extracts. (main.js has a similar NBHD_META, but the
// baseline page always showed these subtitles, so they are kept as-is.)
NBHD_META = ({
  pottstown:       {name: "Pottstown",        subtitle: "Block-group level ACS data for the Pottstown area in Huntersville."},
  westdavidson:    {name: "West Davidson",    subtitle: "Block-group level ACS data for the West Davidson area in Davidson."},
  smithville:      {name: "Smithville",       subtitle: "Block-group level ACS data for the Smithville area in Cornelius."},
  huntingtongreen: {name: "Huntington Green", subtitle: "Block-group level ACS data for the Huntington Green area in Huntersville."},
  eastcatawba:     {name: "East Catawba",     subtitle: "Data coming soon for the East Catawba area in Cornelius.", noData: true}
})

STYLE = ({fontFamily: "Hanken Grotesk, sans-serif", fontSize: "13px"})
ACCENT = "#3f4e75"
RED = "#e05c4b"
BLUE2 = "#6b7fa3"
GOLD = "#f0a500"
MUTED = "#b0b8c8"

// Numeric strings -> numbers, rows sorted by year (charts read the last row as "latest").
prep = rows => rows
  .map(r => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r).map(([k, v]) =>
    [k, k !== "neighborhood_name" && v !== null && v !== "" && !isNaN(v) ? Number(v) : v])))
  .sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year)

DEMO = loadData("nbhd-demographics").then(prep)
ECON = loadData("nbhd-economic").then(prep)
HOUS = loadData("nbhd-housing").then(prep)
EDUC = loadData("nbhd-education").then(prep)
TRAN = loadData("nbhd-transportation").then(prep)
CHLD = loadData("nbhd-childcare").then(prep)

forNbhd = (ds, key) => ds.filter(d => d.neighborhood_name === NBHD_META[key].name)

yMax = (rows, col, padding) => {
  const mx = Math.max(...rows.map(d => d[col] || 0));
  return Math.ceil((mx * padding) / 5) * 5 || 10;
}

yearX = (rows, label = "Year") => ({label, labelOffset: 42, ticks: rows.map(d => d.year), tickFormat: String})

// One neighborhood chart: redraws at the container's width, or says so when
// the selected neighborhood has no rows in this dataset.
ndChart = (ds, key, build, invalidation) => {
  const rows = forNbhd(ds, key);
  if (!rows.length) {
    const p = document.createElement("p");
    p.style.cssText = "color:#e05c4b;padding:12px;font-size:13px;font-family:'Hanken Grotesk',sans-serif";
    p.textContent = "Data unavailable";
    return p;
  }
  return responsive(w => build(rows, w) ?? document.createElement("div"), {invalidation});
}
```

<!-- Neighborhood selector (starts from ?nbhd=… so the nav links land on the right one) -->

```{ojs}
viewof nbhd = {
  const param = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("nbhd");
  let current = NBHD_META[param] ? param : "pottstown";
  const bar = document.createElement("div");
  bar.className = "nbhd-selector";
  bar.style.marginBottom = "24px";
  const buttons = Object.entries(NBHD_META).map(([key, meta]) => {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.type = "button";
    b.className = "nbhd-sel-btn" + (meta.noData ? " no-data" : "");
    b.dataset.nbhd = key;
    b.style.lineHeight = "normal";  // Quarto's OJS styles shrink button line-height
    b.textContent = meta.name;
    b.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (current === key) return;
      current = key;
      sync();
      bar.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    });
    bar.append(b);
    return b;
  });
  function sync() {
    for (const b of buttons) b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.nbhd === current);
  }
  Object.defineProperty(bar, "value", {get: () => current, set: v => { current = v; sync(); }});
  sync();
  return bar;
}
```

::: {.nbhd-section style="margin-top:40px"}
#### Population & Ethnicity

Total population and Hispanic or Latino population share of the block groups approximating this neighborhood, from ACS 5-year estimates.

::: {.g2}

::: {.chart-card title="Total Population" subtitle="Summed across all block groups that approximate this neighborhood" chart="nd-pop-chart"}

```{ojs}
ndChart(DEMO, nbhd, (rows, w) => {
  const mx = Math.max(...rows.map(d => d.total_population));
  return stdPlot({
    width: w, height: 260, marginBottom: 48, style: STYLE,
    x: yearX(rows),
    y: {label: "Population", labelOffset: 48, grid: true, domain: [0, Math.ceil((mx * 1.15) / 50) * 50]},
    marks: [
      Plot.line(rows, {x: "year", y: "total_population", stroke: ACCENT, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot(rows, {x: "year", y: "total_population", fill: ACCENT, r: 4,
        tip: true, title: d => `${d.year}\n${Math.round(d.total_population).toLocaleString()} residents`}),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });
}, invalidation)
```

:::

::: {.chart-card title="Hispanic or Latino Population Rate" subtitle="% of residents identifying as Hispanic or Latino" chart="nd-hl-chart"}

```{ojs}
ndChart(DEMO, nbhd, (rows, w) => stdPlot({
  width: w, height: 240, marginBottom: 36, marginLeft: 54, style: STYLE,
  y: {label: null, domain: rows.map(d => d.year), tickFormat: String},
  x: {label: "Share Hispanic or Latino (%)", labelOffset: 30, grid: true,
      domain: [0, Math.min(100, yMax(rows, "hispanic_rate", 1.3))], tickFormat: d => d + "%"},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(rows, {x: "hispanic_rate", y: "year", fill: RED, rx: 3}),
    Plot.text(rows, {x: "hispanic_rate", y: "year", text: d => (d.hispanic_rate || 0) + "%", dx: 6,
      textAnchor: "start", fill: "var(--ink-2)", fontSize: 12}),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
}), invalidation)
```

::: {.nbhd-section}
#### Race

Share of the population by race, most recent ACS year.

::: {.chart-card title="Racial & Ethnic Composition" subtitle="Share of population by race/ethnicity, most recent ACS year" chart="nd-race-chart"}

```{ojs}
ndChart(DEMO, nbhd, (rows, w) => {
  const RACE_COLORS = {
    "White alone": BLUE2, "Black or Afr. Am.": ACCENT, "Hispanic or Latino": RED,
    "Asian alone": GOLD, "Other / multiracial": MUTED
  };
  const latest = rows[rows.length - 1];
  const total = latest.total_population || 1;
  const other = Math.max(0, total - latest.race_white - latest.race_black - latest.race_asian);
  const raceData = [
    {group: "White alone",         pct: +(latest.race_white / total * 100).toFixed(1)},
    {group: "Black or Afr. Am.",   pct: +(latest.race_black / total * 100).toFixed(1)},
    {group: "Hispanic or Latino",  pct: +(latest.hispanic_latino / total * 100).toFixed(1)},
    {group: "Asian alone",         pct: +(latest.race_asian / total * 100).toFixed(1)},
    {group: "Other / multiracial", pct: +(other / total * 100).toFixed(1)}
  ];
  return stdPlot({
    width: w, height: 280, marginBottom: 56, style: STYLE,
    y: {label: "Share of population (%)", labelOffset: 48, grid: true, domain: [0, 100], tickFormat: d => d + "%"},
    x: {label: null, domain: raceData.map(d => d.group)},
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(raceData, {x: "group", y: "pct", fill: d => RACE_COLORS[d.group], rx: 3}),
      Plot.text(raceData, {x: "group", y: "pct", text: d => d.pct + "%", dy: -8, fill: "var(--ink-2)", fontSize: 12}),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });
}, invalidation)
```

::: {.nbhd-section style="margin-top:40px"}
#### Income

Household income distribution and median household income for residents in this block group.

::: {.g2}

::: {.chart-card title="Household Income Distribution" subtitle="Share of households in each income bracket, most recent ACS year" chart="nd-income-dist-chart"}

```{ojs}
ndChart(ECON, nbhd, (rows, w) => {
  const latest = rows[rows.length - 1];
  const total = latest.total_households || 1;
  const brackets = [
    {label: "Under $25k", pct: +(latest.income_under_25k / total * 100).toFixed(1)},
    {label: "$25k–$50k",  pct: +(latest.income_25k_50k / total * 100).toFixed(1)},
    {label: "$50k–$100k", pct: +(latest.income_50k_100k / total * 100).toFixed(1)},
    {label: "$100k+",     pct: +(latest.income_100k_plus / total * 100).toFixed(1)}
  ];
  return stdPlot({
    width: w, height: 210, marginBottom: 36, marginLeft: 90, style: STYLE,
    x: {label: "Share of households (%) →", labelOffset: 30, domain: [0, 100], tickFormat: d => d + "%"},
    y: {label: null, domain: brackets.map(d => d.label)},
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(brackets, {x: "pct", y: "label", fill: ACCENT, rx: 3}),
      Plot.text(brackets, {x: "pct", y: "label", text: d => d.pct + "%", dx: 6,
        textAnchor: "start", fill: "var(--ink-2)", fontSize: 12}),
      Plot.ruleX([0])
    ]
  });
}, invalidation)
```

:::

::: {.chart-card title="Median Household Income" subtitle="Median household income in dollars" chart="nd-income-trend-chart"}

```{ojs}
ndChart(ECON, nbhd, (rows, w) => stdPlot({

  marks: [

      tip: true, title: d => `${d.year}\n$${Math.round(d.median_household_income).toLocaleString()}`}),
```

::: {.nbhd-section}
#### Income Over Time

How the income bracket mix has shifted since `r since_year`, and how the number of households has grown alongside it.

::: {.g2}

::: {.chart-card title="Household Income Distribution Over Time" subtitle="Share of households in each income bracket, by year" chart="nd-income-dist-trend-chart"}

```{ojs}
ndChart(ECON, nbhd, (rows, w) => {
  const BRACKETS = ["Under $25k", "$25k–$50k", "$50k–$100k", "$100k+"];
  const BRACKET_COLORS = {"Under $25k": "#440154", "$25k–$50k": "#31688e", "$50k–$100k": "#35b779", "$100k+": "#fde725"};
  const long = [];
  rows.forEach(d => {
    const tot = d.total_households || 0;
    if (!tot) return;
    long.push({year: d.year, bracket: "Under $25k", pct: +(d.income_under_25k / tot * 100).toFixed(1)});
    long.push({year: d.year, bracket: "$25k–$50k",  pct: +(d.income_25k_50k / tot * 100).toFixed(1)});
    long.push({year: d.year, bracket: "$50k–$100k", pct: +(d.income_50k_100k / tot * 100).toFixed(1)});
    long.push({year: d.year, bracket: "$100k+",     pct: +(d.income_100k_plus / tot * 100).toFixed(1)});
  });
  if (!long.length) return null;
  return stdPlot({
    width: w, height: 300, marginBottom: 56, marginRight: 20, style: STYLE,
    x: yearX(rows),
    y: {label: "Share of Households (%)", labelOffset: 48, grid: true, domain: [0, 100], tickFormat: d => d + "%"},
    color: {domain: BRACKETS, range: BRACKETS.map(b => BRACKET_COLORS[b]), legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(long, Plot.stackY({order: BRACKETS, x: "year", y: "pct", fill: "bracket",
        tip: true, title: d => `${d.bracket}\n${d.year}: ${d.pct}%`})),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });
}, invalidation)
```

::: {.note source="[ACS]{.gloss} 5-Year Estimates"}
:::

:::

#### Tenure & Home Values

Who owns versus rents in this neighborhood, and how home values and rents compare.

::: {.g2}

::: {.chart-card title="Owner vs. Renter Occupied" subtitle="Share of occupied housing units by tenure, most recent ACS year" chart="nd-tenure-chart"}

```{ojs}
ndChart(HOUS, nbhd, (rows, w) => {
  const latest = rows[rows.length - 1];
  const tenureData = [
    {label: "Owner-occupied",  pct: latest.owner_rate},
    {label: "Renter-occupied", pct: latest.renter_rate}
  ];
  return stdPlot({
    width: w, height: 170, marginBottom: 36, style: STYLE,
    x: {label: "Share of occupied units (%) →", labelOffset: 30, domain: [0, 100], tickFormat: d => d + "%"},
    y: {label: null, domain: tenureData.map(d => d.label)},
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(tenureData, {x: "pct", y: "label", fill: d => d.label.startsWith("Owner") ? ACCENT : RED, rx: 3}),
      Plot.text(tenureData, {x: "pct", y: "label", text: d => d.pct + "%", dx: 6,
        textAnchor: "start", fill: "var(--ink-2)", fontSize: 12}),
      Plot.ruleX([0])
    ]
  });
}, invalidation)
```

:::

::: {.chart-card title="Median Gross Rent & Home Value" subtitle="Most recent ACS estimate" chart="nd-rent-value-chart"}

```{ojs}
ndChart(HOUS, nbhd, (rows, w) => {
  const latest = rows[rows.length - 1];
  const bars = [
    {label: "Median Gross Rent", value: latest.median_gross_rent, note: "/mo"},
    {label: "Median Home Value", value: latest.median_home_value, note: ""}
  ];
  return stdPlot({
    width: w, height: 190, marginBottom: 36, style: STYLE,
    x: {label: "Dollars →", labelOffset: 30, tickFormat: d => "$" + (d / 1000).toFixed(0) + "k"},
    y: {label: null, domain: bars.map(d => d.label)},
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(bars, {x: "value", y: "label", fill: ACCENT, rx: 3}),
      Plot.text(bars, {x: "value", y: "label", text: d => "$" + (d.value || 0).toLocaleString() + d.note,
        dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fill: "var(--ink-2)", fontSize: 12}),
      Plot.ruleX([0])
    ]
  });
}, invalidation)
```

::: {.nbhd-section style="margin-top:40px"}
#### Educational Attainment

Highest level of education completed by residents 25 and older in this neighborhood, and how that mix has shifted since `r since_year`.

::: {.g2}

::: {.chart-card title="Educational Attainment Composition Over Time" subtitle="Share of adults 25+ by highest level completed, by year" chart="nd-attainment-composition-chart"}

```{ojs}
ndChart(EDUC, nbhd, (rows, w) => {
  const LEVELS = ["Less than HS", "HS / Equivalent", "Some College", "Associate's", "Bachelor's", "Graduate/Prof."];
  const LEVEL_COLORS = {
    "Less than HS": "#440154", "HS / Equivalent": "#414487", "Some College": "#2a788e",
    "Associate's": "#22a884", "Bachelor's": "#7ad151", "Graduate/Prof.": "#fde725"
  };
  const COLS = ["n_less_than_hs", "n_hs_or_equiv", "n_some_college", "n_associates", "n_bachelors", "n_graduate_or_prof"];
  const long = [];
  rows.forEach(d => {
    const tot = d.pop_25_plus || 0;
    if (!tot) return;
    LEVELS.forEach((level, i) => long.push({year: d.year, level, pct: +(d[COLS[i]] / tot * 100).toFixed(1)}));
  });
  if (!long.length) return null;
  return stdPlot({
    width: w, height: 300, marginBottom: 70, marginRight: 20, style: STYLE,
    x: yearX(rows),
    y: {label: "Share of Adults 25+ (%)", labelOffset: 48, grid: true, domain: [0, 100], tickFormat: d => d + "%"},
    color: {domain: LEVELS, range: LEVELS.map(l => LEVEL_COLORS[l]), legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(long, Plot.stackY({order: LEVELS, x: "year", y: "pct", fill: "level",
        tip: true, title: d => `${d.level}\n${d.year}: ${d.pct}%`})),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });
}, invalidation)
```

::: {.note source="[ACS]{.gloss} 5-Year Estimates"}
:::

<!-- TAB: Transportation -->

::: {.tabpane data-pane="nd-transportation"}

::: {.wrap}

::: {.nbhd-section style="margin-top:40px"}
#### Commute Mode

How residents get to work: driving alone, transit, walking, cycling, or working from home, and how that mix has shifted since `r since_year`.

::: {.g2}

::: {.chart-card title="Commute Mode Share" subtitle="% of workers by primary mode of transportation, most recent [ACS]{.gloss} year" chart="nd-commute-mode-chart"}

```{ojs}
ndChart(TRAN, nbhd, (rows, w) => {
  const latest = rows[rows.length - 1];
  const other = Math.max(0, +(100 - latest.pct_drove_alone - latest.pct_public_transit - latest.pct_worked_from_home).toFixed(1));
  const modeData = [
    {label: "Drove alone",      pct: latest.pct_drove_alone},
    {label: "Worked from home", pct: latest.pct_worked_from_home},
    {label: "Other",            pct: other},
    {label: "Public transit",   pct: latest.pct_public_transit}
  ];
  return stdPlot({
    width: w, height: 200, marginBottom: 36, style: STYLE,
    x: {label: "Share of workers (%) →", labelOffset: 30, domain: [0, 100], tickFormat: d => d + "%"},
    y: {label: null, domain: modeData.map(d => d.label)},
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(modeData, {x: "pct", y: "label", fill: ACCENT, rx: 3}),
      Plot.text(modeData, {x: "pct", y: "label", text: d => d.pct + "%", dx: 6,
        textAnchor: "start", fill: "var(--ink-2)", fontSize: 12}),
      Plot.ruleX([0])
    ]
  });
}, invalidation)
```

:::

::: {.chart-card title="Commute Mode Over Time" subtitle="Share of workers driving alone, using public transit, or working from home, by year" chart="nd-commute-trend-chart"}

```{ojs}
ndChart(TRAN, nbhd, (rows, w) => {
  const long = [];
  rows.forEach(d => {
    long.push({year: d.year, series: "Drove alone",      pct: d.pct_drove_alone});
    long.push({year: d.year, series: "Public transit",   pct: d.pct_public_transit});
    long.push({year: d.year, series: "Worked from home", pct: d.pct_worked_from_home});
  });
  const SERIES_COLORS = {"Drove alone": ACCENT, "Public transit": BLUE2, "Worked from home": GOLD};
  return stdPlot({
    width: w, height: 240, marginBottom: 48, style: STYLE,
    x: yearX(rows),
    y: {label: "Share of workers (%)", labelOffset: 48, grid: true, domain: [0, 100], tickFormat: d => d + "%"},
    color: {domain: Object.keys(SERIES_COLORS), range: Object.values(SERIES_COLORS), legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.line(long, {x: "year", y: "pct", stroke: "series", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot(long, {x: "year", y: "pct", fill: "series", r: 3.5,
        tip: true, title: d => `${d.series}\n${d.year}: ${d.pct}%`}),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });
}, invalidation)
```

::: {.note source="[ACS]{.gloss} 5-Year Estimates"}
:::

:::

:::

Remote work reshaped commuting patterns nationally after 2020. Tracking it locally shows how much of that shift reached this neighborhood, and how its working-age population has grown alongside it.

```{ojs}
      domain: [0, Math.ceil(Math.max(...rows.map(d => d.pct_worked_from_home || 0)) * 1.2 / 5) * 5 || 20]},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(rows, {x: "year", y: "pct_worked_from_home", stroke: GOLD, strokeWidth: 2.5}),

      tip: true, title: d => `${d.year}\n${d.pct_worked_from_home}% worked from home`}),
```
